spots.name: Southern Cross
spots.bio: Golden Pipeline town on the Great Eastern Highway with star-named streets, a pioneer cemetery and Wimmera Hill Lookout.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM locality relation/11690087 "Southern Cross" centre (label point) via Nominatim
spots.note: Golden Pipeline highway town with its own draws (Wimmera Hill Lookout, the star-named streets, the cemetery) beside its museum; 105 km east of Merredin, outside its span; one kept spot is too few for a destination.

spots.name: Yilgarn History Museum
spots.bio: Museum in Southern Cross's 1892 courthouse with a working gold-battery model, a camel wagon and mining displays.
spots.note: In Southern Cross; Southern Cross is not a destination.

spots.name: Narrogin
spots.bio: Wheatbelt regional town and base for Dryandra Woodland, with a heritage walk trail and the Old Court House Museum.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM locality relation/11689081 "Narrogin" centre (label point) via Nominatim
spots.note: Regional town and the base for Dryandra; its kept neighbours are a national park (never a spot of a town) and its sanctuary, so it has no destination cluster of its own.

spots.name: Cue
spots.bio: Murchison gold town with a heritage streetscape and discovery centre, the base for Walga Rock and Big Bell.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM locality relation/11690058 "Cue" centre (label point) via Nominatim
spots.note: Murchison town; Walga Rock (48 km) is its one kept neighbour, too few for a destination.

spots.name: Mount Magnet
spots.bio: Murchison gold town with a 37 km tourist trail to Warrmboo Hill views and a mining and pastoral museum.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM locality relation/11690059 "Mount Magnet" centre (label point) via Nominatim
spots.note: Murchison town 80 km south of Cue; no kept spots of its own nearby.

spots.name: Meekatharra
spots.bio: Largest Murchison town on the Great Northern Highway, with a heritage walk, a state battery and Peace Gorge nearby.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM locality relation/11690201 "Meekatharra" centre (label point) via Nominatim
spots.note: Murchison town on the Great Northern Highway; no kept neighbours (Peace Gorge is review).

spots.name: Sandstone
spots.bio: Remote gold-rush town with restored heritage buildings, a heritage trail, a museum and the Peter Denny Lookout.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM locality relation/11690205 "Sandstone" centre (label point) via Nominatim
spots.note: Remote gold-rush town with its own heritage streets, museum and lookout beside London Bridge (3 km); one kept neighbour is too few for a destination.

spots.name: London Bridge
spots.bio: Natural rock arch about 350 million years old, 3 km south of Sandstone, a picnic and sunset spot for over a century.
spots.note: 3 km south of Sandstone; Sandstone is not a destination.

spots.name: Wiluna
spots.bio: Outback town at the start of the Canning Stock Route, with heritage walk trails and the Last of the Nomads statue.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM locality relation/11690168 "Wiluna" centre (label point) via Nominatim
spots.note: Gateway town for the Canning Stock Route with its own heritage walks and statue; its three kept neighbours (gallery, discovery centre, North Pool) are fewer than four, so it is not a destination.

spots.name: Tjukurba Art Gallery
spots.bio: Working gallery in Wiluna where Martu artists paint, with their works and historic photographs on show.
spots.note: In Wiluna; Wiluna is not a destination.

spots.name: Canning-Gunbarrel Discovery Centre
spots.bio: Museum in Wiluna's restored old hospital on the town, the Canning Stock Route and the Gunbarrel Highway.
spots.note: In Wiluna; Wiluna is not a destination.

spots.name: North Pool
spots.bio: Waterhole 15 km from Wiluna among red earth and gum trees, for a picnic, a walk or the sunset.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM natural=water "North Pool", Wiluna, via Nominatim
spots.note: 15 km from Wiluna; Wiluna is not a destination.
